BUSH PILOT VR v1.04 - PA-18 Super Cub bush delivery: take jobs off the strip boards, load and strap the cargo, fly it out. Fragile, perishable and live cargo, bush sites, deer hunting jobs, airdrops, running costs (fuel, oil, wear, repairs), reputation with every customer (better pay, requests, the Halvorsen board), plane upgrades from the hangar parts board (long-range tank, tundra tyres, cargo pod, LED light, COM radio), townsfolk with their own stories, medevac and search-and-rescue call-outs. No wind, no weather. You start on foot by the Cub at the cabin strip. Walk up to her and climb in (F / Y), then start her up off the checklist card (J). Desktop - flying: W/S or arrows pitch, A/D or arrows roll, Q/E rudder, Shift / Ctrl (or + / -) throttle, B brakes, \ parking brake, [ ] flaps, PgUp / PgDn trim, R reset to the strip (cold and dark), F climb out, M map, L landing light, Home recentre, mouse looks (click to capture). Desktop - engine: U fuel valve, O master, Y mixture, H carb heat, P primer, I mags (OFF > R > L > BOTH), hold Space = starter, K panel lights, 1-4 windows / door, 5 cargo door, J checklist card, N clipboard (, and . turn its pages: JOBS, W&B, CUB, PERF). Desktop - on foot: WASD walk, Shift run, C crouch, Space hop, F climb in, G refuel at the strip pump (near a wing filler cap), M map. Jobs: 1-3 at a job board accept / cancel, E pick up / set down cargo (E by the Cub loads or unloads it), / seat belt + cargo net. Hunting: T take / sling / rack the rifle, LMB fire, RMB aim, X lever, Z load a round (ammo is sold only at the Dry Fork hangar's HARDWARE counter: $35 a box of 20, Z again takes it; you start with 20 in the pouch), V binoculars, hold E by a downed deer to field dress it. Airdrops: in flight open the right door (1 upper window, 2 lower door), G pushes the next bundle out - drop it on the smoke / X. Running costs: fuel is paid at the red drums (4 strips, 4 prices); oil, tyres + brakes, repairs and the 100-hour service at the home HANGAR board (1-4 there). VR - in the cockpit: grip the stick (right) and throttle (left), left stick = rudder, left trigger = brakes, reach up and pull the flap handle down a notch at a time, wind the trim crank, turn knobs / the mag key / the primer / the fuel valve with your hand; every cockpit control needs the grip (yellow ring = what it takes); the parking brake T-handle: grip it and pull it out along its shaft to set, push it in to release. Binoculars: the 7x view comes up inside 12 cm of your eyes and drops past 16 cm (v0.84.7: fixed in the headset). Grip the clipboard on your thigh to lift it, its hand's trigger turns the page. A / X recentre, B reset, Y climb out. Turn your left wrist to your face and poke its MENU button with your right finger for SETTINGS. VR - on foot: left stick walks (click = run), right stick turns (snap / smooth in Settings), right stick down = crouch, up = hop, Y climb in, take the nozzle off a red drum, put it in a wing filler cap and hold the trigger to refuel from the pump, grab the map off its cockpit holder. Jobs: poke ACCEPT on a strip's job board, grip cargo to carry it, let go over the rear seat / baggage bay, grab the belt buckle / net to strap. Hunting (v0.85: the new model, the v0.44 handling): grip the rifle's wrist (cabin / Cub rack; right stick in + up / down = grip angle), other hand on the forend, trigger fires, grab the lever loop with your other hand and swing it (or flick, or B / Y), rounds from the belt pouch into the gate; binoculars in the holster on your left hip (one hand or both, a hand on each barrel), raise them to your eyes; grip and hold a downed deer to dress it. Airdrops: unlatch + open both halves of the right door, reach back and grip a bundle, put your hand out through the door and let go. Running costs: carry the drum's nozzle to a wing cap (trigger pumps) to buy fuel; poke a price on the hangar / fuel boards for oil, tyres, repairs, the 100-hour. MENU (Esc / F2 on desktop, the wrist MENU button in VR; poke, point + trigger, or click): resume, save / load (3 slots), graphics + presets, comfort, controls (dominant hand), audio volumes. ` = old settings list.
